mapper.select: SELECT 'total' AS `key`, '全部任务' AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM daily_task WHERE task_date = #{todayDate} UNION ALL SELECT 'unfinish' AS `key`, '待完成' AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM daily_task WHERE task_date = #{todayDate} AND is_finish = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'finish' AS `key`, '已完成' AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM daily_task WHERE task_date = #{todayDate} AND is_finish = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'rate' AS `key`, '完成率' AS label, ROUND(IF(COUNT(*) = 0, 0, SUM(is_finish) / COUNT(*) * 100), 0) AS value FROM daily_task WHERE task_date = #{todayDate}
